scope: Elapsed wall between outer command completion and final report/table observation; includes read-only evidence inspection, report writing, tool latency or idle; not a dedicated CPU-time measurement and not part of any arm process wall
correction_note: Initial derived receipt parsed an already-deserialized UTC DateTime as local +08:00 and lost its fractional seconds, inflating the subtraction by about eight hours. The initial bytes are preserved separately; the corrected interval is the arithmetic difference between the two written UTC timestamps. This is elapsed wall, not CPU time.
